What if you never went outside?
Between work, school and screens, lots of people spend whole days indoors. You'd miss a lot of sunshine. Many people now spend about ninety percent of their time indoors.

But here's the twist. Your skin makes vitamin D from sunlight, and studies show kids who spend more time outdoors are less likely to become nearsighted! Even fifteen to thirty minutes of daylight can boost your mood and help you sleep better at night. Time in green spaces and parks is also linked to lower stress and a better mood.
